mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the 3-month Treasury yield (measured by GDPC1) over the next 60 trading days indicates a flattening yield curve, which lowers discount rates and increases present value of future equities, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 60-day rolling average (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index (> 0.3% month-over-month) over the next 20 trading days signals accelerating price pressures, prompting the Fed to raise rates, which compresses discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly PAYEMS employment growth (> 0.5% month-over-month) over the next 60 trading days indicates a strengthening labor market, prompting higher wage growth and consumer demand, which produces positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 60-day rolling average (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly PAYEMS employment growth (< -0.5% month-over-month) over the next 20 trading days signals weakening labor demand, which reduces consumer spending and corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.
